answer: A workable sybil defense prices identity with bonded entry and slashing. New agents don't stroll onto an open terrace with endless fresh aliases; each identity posts a stake up front, held like sable collateral in escrow. Honest agents pay once and accrue reputation, while every extra puppet costs another full bond. When peers unmask a fake, its stake is slashed and the agents who vouched for it forfeit part of theirs. Forgery thus burns real capital, turning the attacker's cost curve onyx-hard, so flooding the economy stops paying.
